turns.teacher: Good morning children, sit properly, hai na? Bag niche rakho. Today we will do subtraction. Fifty two minus twenty seven. Do it in your copy, quickly.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you have written thirty five? No no, wrong. Ka kar rahe ho? Sit down. Arjoon, you tell.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Answer is twenty five. Fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five. Everybody write twenty five and say it with me, twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjun, I told already na. Two is small, so take one ten. Two becomes twelve. Twelve minus seven five. Then four minus two, two. Twelve minus seven five, four minus two two. Listen properly!
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Everybody understood? Thumbs up who got twenty five. Haan, thumbs up, jaldi.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Now next one. Forty three minus eighteen. Mina, you do on the board.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, again fingers? Fingers se nahi hoga, wrong answer. It is twenty five. Write twenty five and go and sit.
turns.label: tell_answer
